question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Preposterous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Outrageous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Preposterous: **Contrary to reason or common sense; utterly absurd or ridiculous. (अतिरिक्त)
 
• **Outrageous:** Shockingly bad or excessive. (अत्यधिक, भद्दा)
 
• As we can see, the synonym for the word "Preposterous" from the given options is "Outrageous".
